subject: Impact verification and remedy proposal for 2028-03-14 tokenization pause
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Clearline SRE <sre@clearline.com>, Nicole Park <nicole.park@clearline.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observed tokenization pause on 2028-03-14 — need impact window

Hi Nicole / Clearline SRE team,

We detected a short-lived tokenization service pause impacting requests to your tenant between ~2028-03-14 21:37:00 UTC and 21:44:30 UTC (approx). Our telemetry shows a spike of 5xx/429 and elevated tail latency for tokenization calls during that window.

Could you confirm whether you saw the same window on your side and, if possible, send any raw logs or correlation IDs? We need the exact impact window and affected endpoints to determine SLA eligibility and propose any remedial credit.

Action items we suggest:
- Clearline: share logs / the correlation IDs (if available).
- Redwood (David): pull trace bundle for that timeframe.
- Agree expected meeting time to walk through evidence (30 min).

I can compile an initial credit estimate once we have synchronized windows.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
SRE Escalations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message
From: Nicole Park <nicole.park@clearline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clearline SRE <sre@clearline.com>, ops@clearline.com
Date: 2028-03-16T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed tokenization pause on 2028-03-14 — need impact window

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for flagging. We see the same brief degradation in our monitoring around 2028-03-14 21:36:55–21:44:10 UTC. I've attached a trimmed log bundle with request IDs and our internal error counters for the period (clearline_logs_20280314.zip).

Preliminary notes from our side:
- Most failures are 503s from our tokenization client between host-a and the Redwood tokenization endpoint.
- Traffic returned to normal once clients retried (within ~3 attempts), but it did affect a subset of high-throughput checkout lanes for ~7–8 minutes.

We'd like to schedule a short review with Redwood SRE and our payments engineering team. I can be available tomorrow between 09:00–12:00 PT.

Nicole Park
Payments Engineering Manager
Clearline Payments

Attachment: clearline_logs_20280314.zip (log bundle, 4.2MB)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Nicole Park <nicole.park@clearline.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-17T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed tokenization pause on 2028-03-14 — need impact window

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 09:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We detected a short-lived tokenization service pause impacting requests to your tenant...

Nicole / Soojin,

I pulled our trace and request-level telemetry for the Clearline tenant and confirmed an elevated error rate and queue saturation on the tokenizer shard serving your region for the time range Nicole provided. I uploaded the trace bundle (redwood_trace_bundle_20280314.tar.gz) — it includes KV-cache stats, per-request latency, and scheduler queue depth snapshots.

Observations:
- Error spike aligns closely with Clearline's 21:36:55–21:44:10 UTC window.
- Queue depth jumped ~4x for ~6 minutes while autoscaler reacted; a couple of tokenization workers experienced a transient OOM and restarted.
- Root cause signal: a sudden upstream traffic burst with large batched requests that pushed shard memory usage over threshold.

I'll prepare an initial remedial credit estimate and a short postmortem draft. Proposed next steps:
1) Joint evidence review (30 min).
2) Postmortem with RCA and mitigations (canary limits, backpressure, improved autoscaler warmup).
3) Credit calculation and contractual proposal (if eligible).

-David
David Kim
SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_trace_bundle_20280314.tar.gz (trace bundle, 12MB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nicole Park <nicole.park@clearline.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed tokenization pause on 2028-03-14 — need impact window

Thanks for the logs and trace bundle — both line up, which helps. I've run a preliminary SLA-eligibility calc and attached a working sheet (sla_credit_calc_20280320.xlsx) to show the assumptions. Quick summary:

- Confirmed impact window for Clearline: 2028-03-14 21:37:00–21:44:10 UTC (7m10s).
- Effect: increased 5xx rate and higher tokenization tail latency for ~6–8 minutes; some requests retried and completed.
- Contract excerpt: tokenization availability measured at 99.95% monthly for your plan; a contiguous outage >5 minutes is eligible for proportional credit under Section 4.3.

Preliminary credit proposal (subject to legal/finance review): prorated monthly credit equivalent to 0.005% of monthly committed spend for the affected billing window. I included both a conservative and a permissive calculation in the sheet.

Proposed cadence:
- Tomorrow: 30-minute evidence review (I'll send a calendar invite for 2028-03-19 10:30 PT).
- Follow-up: joint postmortem and mitigation commitments within one week.
- Finance: finalize credit once postmortem is agreed and the impact window is validated.

Please confirm the meeting or suggest a time.

Best,
Soojin Lee
SRE Escalations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sla_credit_calc_20280320.xlsx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Nicole Park <nicole.park@clearline.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-20T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Impact verification and remedy proposal for 2028-03-14 tokenization pause

Nicole / team — thanks for the quick turn here. I'm looping in Customer Success and our PricingOps lead to streamline the credit path.

Immediate asks from Redwood:
- Accept the meeting 2028-03-19 10:30 PT (or propose an alternative).
- Confirm whether you want a standard prorated credit or prefer an invoice adjustment + one-time service credit (we can walk options with Finance on the call).

We will hold the credit calculation as provisional until the joint postmortem confirms the final impact window and extent. If Finance needs any additional paperwork ahead of the call (SLA impact form, signed acceptance), let me know and we'll surface it.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
